name: terminal
description: A Mac-style terminal window: typed commands after a prompt, the text they print back, notes and errors. Steps swap its lines with `set`; there is no typing animation.

prompt.description: the prompt before each command line, e.g. `~/Reports %` (a line's own prompt wins)

badge.description: a chip in the title bar, e.g. `typed by Claude`

kind.description: cmd: a typed command after the prompt; out: what the computer printed; note: an aside in plain words (not real output); err: an error message

prompt.description: this command line's prompt, e.g. after a `cd`
